name: NetworkMap
title: NetworkMap
summary: An abstract dot map of the Global Bible Network with a legend, gold partner-hub pins and a tooltip, beside a selectable list of regions with partner counts.
whenToUse: Use on the Global Bible Network and About pages to show where ISM works with partners and stations.
Use the region list as the main control; the map illustrates it.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for directions or exact locations; it is abstract on purpose.
Do not use for a single station; use StationCard.

anatomy.description: Two cards in `.mn-netmap`: the map card (spans 2 of 3 columns) and the regions card.

props.name: regions
props.description: Regions in list order. The list is the keyboard path; the map illustrates it.

props.name: stations
props.description: Partner hub pins. Gold, never blue or red.

props.name: onSelectedRegionChange
props.description: Called when a region row is chosen (never for coming-soon rows).

props.name: activeStationId
props.default: the first station of the selected region

props.name: offDots
props.description: Path data for the grey "not yet active" background dots.

props.name: mapLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the map: one `role="img"` that states the selection and where hubs are.

props.name: title
props.description: Map card title, e.g. "Global Bible Network".

props.name: note
props.description: Note under the map, e.g. "Choose a region or a pin to see its stations, partners and languages."

props.name: summary
props.description: Footer summary, e.g. `<>383 partners in 61 countries`.

props.name: joinLabel
props.description: Footer link label, e.g. "Join". Shown with ↗.

variantNotes: Map dots: not active `.mn-map-off` (`--gray-200`), network region `.mn-map-on` (`--blue-on-dark`), selected region `.mn-map-sel` (`--horizon-blue`).
Pins `.mn-map-pins`: `--gradient-gold` with a white ring; the active pin is larger with a `.mn-map-halo`; its tooltip `.mn-map-tip` is `--charcoal-900` with white 12px text.

Region row `.mn-rrow` (52px): default, hover (`--off-white`), selected (`aria-pressed="true"`, `--blue-tint`, dot `.mn-c-sel`), focus ring, coming soon (`.mn-rrow-soon`, `aria-disabled="true"`, grey).
Under 768px the two cards stack, map first.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Selecting a row recolours its dot and the map region; only one region is selected at a time.
Horizon Blue marks only the selected region. Partner hubs are gold, never blue or red.
Keep the legend visible above the map; it explains every colour used.
Counts are tabular numbers, right-aligned. Mark the map as abstract and counts as samples until confirmed.
The footer link goes to the partner page, so it uses ↗.

accessibility: The SVG is one `role="img"` with an `aria-label` that states the selection and where hubs are.
The region list is the keyboard path: real `<button>`s with `aria-pressed`. Do not make map dots the only control.
Coming-soon rows use `aria-disabled="true"` and ignore clicks.
Colour dots are paired with names and the legend; never rely on colour alone.
